   262	// 7. ~/.agents/skills entries that clash with this plugin's skill names.
   263	const skillsDir = path.join(home, ".agents", "skills");
   264	
   265	// Where a symlink points, if it lands inside one of this marketplace's plugins:
   266	// a repo checkout (found by its marketplace file) or an installed copy (found
   267	// by a plugin manifest named like one of our plugins, as in a plugin cache).
   268	// Returns { plugin, skill } for the duplicate name it creates, or null.
   269	const OUR_PLUGINS = [PLUGIN, ...MIRRORS];
   270	function linkTarget(linkPath) {
   271	  let target;
   272	  try {
   273	    target = path.resolve(path.dirname(linkPath), fs.readlinkSync(linkPath));
   274	  } catch {
   275	    return null;
   276	  }
   277	  for (const start of new Set([target, real(target)])) {
   278	    let skill = null;
   279	    for (let dir = start; ; dir = path.dirname(dir)) {
   280	      if (path.basename(path.dirname(dir)) === "skills") skill = path.basename(dir);
   281	      for (const m of [[".claude-plugin", "plugin.json"], [".codex-plugin", "plugin.json"]]) {
   282	        const name = readJson(path.join(dir, ...m))?.name;
   283	        if (OUR_PLUGINS.includes(name)) return { plugin: name, skill: skill ?? name };
   284	      }
   285	      for (const m of [[".claude-plugin", "marketplace.json"], [".agents", "plugins", "marketplace.json"]]) {
   286	        if (readJson(path.join(dir, ...m))?.name === MARKETPLACE) return { plugin: null, skill };
   287	      }
   288	      if (path.dirname(dir) === dir) break;
   289	    }
   290	  }
   291	  return null;
   292	}
   293	
   294	const clashes = [];
   295	let entries = [];
   296	try {
   297	  entries = fs.readdirSync(skillsDir);
   298	} catch {
   299	  // No ~/.agents/skills: nothing can clash.
   300	}
   301	for (const name of entries.sort()) {
   302	  const p = path.join(skillsDir, name);
   303	  const st = lstat(p);
   304	  if (!st) continue;
   305	  const target = st.isSymbolicLink() ? linkTarget(p) : null;
   306	  if (target) {
   307	    const dup = target.plugin ? `${target.plugin}:${target.skill}` : `${MARKETPLACE} plugin`;
   308	    clashes.push({ p, st, why: `${p} links into ${target.plugin ? `an installed or checked-out ${target.plugin} plugin` : `a copy of the ${MARKETPLACE} repo`}`, dup });
   309	  } else if (name === PLUGIN) {
   310	    clashes.push({ p, st, why: `${p} exists`, maybe: true });
   311	  }
   312	}
   313	if (!clashes.length) {
   314	  ok(`no ${skillsDir} entry clashes with the ${MARKETPLACE} skills`);
   315	}
   316	for (const { p, st, why, dup, maybe } of clashes) {
   317	  const rm = st.isDirectory() && !st.isSymbolicLink() ? "rm -r" : "rm";
   318	  const effect = maybe
   319	    ? `It may clash with the ${PLUGIN} skill in Codex, and the README advises against any ${PLUGIN} entry there`
   320	    : `It creates a duplicate ${dup} skill name in Codex, which then loads neither copy`;
   321	  warn(`${why}. ${effect}`, `${rm} ${shq(p)}`);
   322	}
   323	
   324	process.exitCode = failed ? 1 : 0;

     1	import assert from "node:assert/strict";
     2	import { spawn, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
     3	import fs from "node:fs";
     4	import path from "node:path";
     5	import { describe, test } from "node:test";
     6	import { pluginRoot, readPlugin, read, tempPlugin, tempConfigDirs } from "./helpers.mjs";
     7	import {
     8	  alwaysOnSetting,

    21	import { composeChunks, loadConfig, loadPins } from "../tools/build.mjs";
    22	
    23	const hooksJson = JSON.parse(readPlugin("hooks", "hooks.json"));
    24	const [group] = hooksJson.hooks.SessionStart;
    25	const handlers = group.hooks;
    26	const { body: bundleBody } = composeChunks(loadConfig().plugins.find((p) => p.name === "adhd-unslop"), loadPins());
    27	
    28	// Run chunk handler n the way a runtime does: Claude Code sets only
    29	// CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; Codex sets PLUGIN_ROOT and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT.
    30	function runHandler(n, { root = pluginRoot, env = {}, runtime = "claude", source = "startup", input } = {}) {
    31	  const cleanEnv = { PATH: process.env.PATH, HOME: env.HOME ?? "/nonexistent-home", ...env, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT: root };
    32	  if (runtime === "codex") cleanEnv.PLUGIN_ROOT = root;
    33	  const stdin = input ?? JSON.stringify({ session_id: "t", hook_event_name: "SessionStart", source });
    34	  return spawnSync("sh", ["-c", handlers[n - 1].command], { env: cleanEnv, encoding: "utf8", input: stdin });
    35	}
    36	
    37	function optIn(dir) {
    38	  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, FLAG_NAME), "");
    39	}
    40	
    41	function configEnv() {
    42	  const cfg = tempConfigDirs();
    43	  return { cfg, env: { CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: cfg.claude, CODEX_HOME: cfg.codex } };
    44	}

    46	describe("hooks.json", () => {
    47	  test("one SessionStart group with three synchronous handlers, one per chunk, all four sources", () => {
    48	    assert.equal(hooksJson.hooks.SessionStart.length, 1);
    49	    assert.equal(handlers.length, TOTAL_CHUNKS);
    50	    for (const src of ["startup", "resume", "clear", "compact"]) assert.match(group.matcher, new RegExp(`\\b${src}\\b`));
    51	    handlers.forEach((h, i) => {
    52	      assert.equal(h.type, "command");
    53	      assert.ok(h.command.includes(`ADHD_UNSLOP_CHUNK='${i + 1}'`), `handler ${i + 1} sets its chunk`);
    54	      assert.ok(h.command.includes("process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT") && h.command.includes("process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT"));
    55	      assert.notEqual(h.async, true);
    56	      assert.equal(typeof h.additionalContextLimit, "number");
    57	    });
    58	  });
    59	
    60	  test("the chunk handlers match the definitions Codex users trusted in 0.2.2", () => {
    61	    // Codex keys trust by hooks file path, group, and handler index, and hashes

    63	    // group sends every Codex user back to /hooks.
    64	    assert.deepEqual(group, JSON.parse(read("tests", "fixtures", "trusted-session-start-group.json")));
    65	  });

    67	  test("each emitted value fits both runtime caps with fixed 120-char flag paths", () => {

    69	    handlers.forEach((h, i) => {
    70	      const r = renderChunk(pluginRoot, i + 1, { flags: fixture, tokenLimit: h.additionalContextLimit });
    71	      assert.ok(r.ok, r.reason);
    72	      assert.ok(r.text.length < 9000, `chunk ${i + 1} is ${r.text.length} chars`);
    73	      assert.ok(r.tokens <= 2500, `chunk ${i + 1} is ~${r.tokens} tokens, over the Codex default`);
    74	    });

    85	describe("opt-in and runtime helpers", () => {
    86	  test("ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS values", () => {
    87	    for (const v of ["0", "false", "off", "OFF", " Off "]) assert.equal(alwaysOnSetting({ ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS: v }).mode, "off", v);
    88	    for (const v of ["1", "true", "on", "ON"]) assert.equal(alwaysOnSetting({ ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS: v }).mode, "on", v);
    89	    for (const v of [undefined, ""]) assert.equal(alwaysOnSetting({ ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS: v }).mode, "unset");

    96	    assert.equal(optedIn({ ...env, ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS: "1" }, "/nonexistent-home"), true);
    97	    optIn(cfg.claude);
    98	    assert.equal(optedIn(env, "/nonexistent-home"), true);
    99	    assert.equal(optedIn({ ...env, ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS: "0" }, "/nonexistent-home"), false);

   130	describe("always-on launcher", () => {
   131	  test("silent without a flag", () => {
   132	    const { env } = configEnv();
   133	    for (let n = 1; n <= TOTAL_CHUNKS; n++) {
   134	      const r = runHandler(n, { env });

     1	import assert from "node:assert/strict";
     2	import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
     3	import fs from "node:fs";
     4	import os from "node:os";
     5	import path from "node:path";
     6	import { describe, test } from "node:test";
     7	import { repo, read, proseOnly, trackTemp } from "./helpers.mjs";
     8	
     9	const plugins = path.join(repo, "plugins");
    10	const SCRIPT = path.join("skills", "doctor", "scripts", "doctor.mjs");
    11	const FLAG = ".adhd-unslop-always";
    12	const MIRRORS = ["au-i-have-adhd", "au-unslop"];
    13	const versionOf = (dir) => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, ".claude-plugin", "plugin.json"), "utf8")).version;
    14	
    15	// A throwaway home with empty Claude Code and Codex config dirs.
    16	function tempDirs() {
    17	  const base = trackTemp(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "adhd-unslop-doctor-")));
    18	  const home = path.join(base, "home");
    19	  const claude = path.join(home, ".claude");
    20	  const codex = path.join(home, ".codex");
    21	  for (const d of [claude, codex]) fs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true });
    22	  return { base, home, claude, codex };
    23	}
    24	
    25	// Copy whole generated plugin dirs so a test can break them.
    26	function copyPlugins(dest, names = ["adhd-unslop", ...MIRRORS]) {
    27	  for (const n of names) fs.cpSync(path.join(plugins, n), path.join(dest, n), { recursive: true });
    28	  return path.join(dest, "adhd-unslop");
    29	}
    30	
    31	function runDoctor(dirs, { root = path.join(plugins, "adhd-unslop"), env = {} } = {}) {
    32	  const clean = { PATH: process.env.PATH, HOME: dirs.home, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: dirs.claude, CODEX_HOME: dirs.codex, ...env };
    33	  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(clean)) if (v === undefined) delete clean[k];
    34	  const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, [path.join(root, SCRIPT)], { env: clean, encoding: "utf8" });
    35	  const lines = r.stdout.split("\n").filter(Boolean);
    36	  return {
    37	    ...r,
    38	    lines,
    39	    oks: lines.filter((l) => l.startsWith("OK   ")),
    40	    warns: lines.filter((l) => l.startsWith("WARN ")),
    41	    fails: lines.filter((l) => l.startsWith("FAIL ")),
    42	    has: (re) => lines.some((l) => re.test(l)),
    43	  };
    44	}
    45	
    46	// The line right after a WARN or FAIL line that matches `re`.
    47	function fixFor(r, re) {
    48	  const i = r.lines.findIndex((l) => /^(WARN|FAIL) /.test(l) && re.test(l));
    49	  assert.ok(i >= 0, `no WARN or FAIL line matching ${re}:\n${r.stdout}`);
    50	  assert.match(r.lines[i + 1] ?? "", /^ {5}fix: \S/);
    51	  return r.lines[i + 1];
    52	}
    53	
    54	function snapshot(dir) {
    55	  const out = [];
    56	  const walk = (d) => {
    57	    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    58	      const p = path.join(d, e.name);
    59	      const st = fs.lstatSync(p);
    60	      out.push(`${path.relative(dir, p)} ${st.size} ${st.mtimeMs}`);
    61	      if (e.isDirectory()) walk(p);
    62	    }
    63	  };
    64	  walk(dir);
    65	  return out.sort();
    66	}

    68	describe("doctor output", () => {
    69	  test("clean checkout: exit 0, no WARN or FAIL, every line in the report format", () => {
    70	    const r = runDoctor(tempDirs());
    71	    assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stdout + r.stderr);
    72	    assert.equal(r.stderr, "");
    73	    assert.deepEqual(r.fails, []);
    74	    assert.deepEqual(r.warns, []);
    75	    for (const l of r.lines) assert.match(l, /^(OK {3}|WARN |FAIL | {5}fix: | {5}then: )\S/, l);
    76	    assert.ok(r.has(/^OK {3}runtime: unknown \(source checkout\?\)$/), r.stdout);
    77	    assert.ok(r.has(new RegExp(`^OK {3}plugin root: .*plugins[/\\\\]adhd-unslop$`)), r.stdout);
    78	    assert.ok(r.has(new RegExp(`^OK {3}adhd-unslop version ${versionOf(path.join(plugins, "adhd-unslop")).replace(/\./g, "\\.")}$`)));
    79	    for (const m of MIRRORS) assert.ok(r.has(new RegExp(`^OK {3}${m}: installed \\(${versionOf(path.join(plugins, m)).replace(/\./g, "\\.")}\\)$`)), m);
    80	    for (const i of [1, 2, 3]) assert.ok(r.has(new RegExp(`^OK {3}chunk ${i} of 3: hash matches, \\d+ of 10000 characters`)), `chunk ${i}`);
    81	    assert.ok(r.has(/^OK {3}always-on is off: no flag file/));
    82	    assert.ok(!r.has(/Codex hooks|SessionStart/), "no Codex checks without a Codex runtime or config.toml");
    83	  });

    91	    assert.ok(r.lines.includes(`OK   flag file present: ${flag}`), r.stdout);

    93	    assert.ok(r.has(/^OK {3}always-on is on: flag file /), r.stdout);

    95	  });

    12	export function trackTemp(dir) {
    13	  temps.push(dir);
    14	  return dir;
    15	}

    17	export const repo = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
    18	export const read = (...p) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(repo, ...p), "utf8");
    19	export const pluginRoot = path.join(repo, "plugins", "adhd-unslop");
    20	export const readPlugin = (...p) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(pluginRoot, ...p), "utf8");

    22	// Copy the runtime parts of the plugin into a temp root so tests can break them.
    23	export function tempPlugin() {
    24	  const root = trackTemp(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "adhd-unslop-plugin-")));
    25	  for (const rel of ["hooks", "skills"]) fs.cpSync(path.join(pluginRoot, rel), path.join(root, rel), { recursive: true });
    26	  return root;
    27	}

    32	  const codex = path.join(base, "codex");
    33	  fs.mkdirSync(claude);
    34	  fs.mkdirSync(codex);

    41	    .replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, "")
    42	    .replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, "")
    43	    .replace(/`[^`\n]*`/g, "");

     9	const overlayDir = ["src", "adhd-unslop", "overlay"];
    10	const overlayFiles = fs.readdirSync(path.join(repo, ...overlayDir)).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".md")).sort();
    11	const overlayText = overlayFiles.map((f) => read(...overlayDir, f)).join("\n");

    14	const RULE7 = ["additionally", "crucial", "delve", "enduring", "enhance", "fostering", "garner", "interplay", "intricate", "landscape", "pivotal", "showcase", "tapestry", "testament", "underscore", "vibrant"];
    15	const HEADING_ALLOW = new Set(["ADHD", "AI", "Claude", "Code", "Codex", "README", "PR", "JSON", "URL", "URLs", "Lifecycle"]);
    16	
    17	describe("overlay prose passes the mechanical unslop checks", () => {
    18	  test("no em dash, no en dash as a dash, no curly quotes", () => {
    19	    assert.doesNotMatch(prose, /—/, "em dash");
    20	    assert.doesNotMatch(prose, /\s–\s/, "en dash as dash");
    21	    assert.doesNotMatch(prose, /[“”‘’]/, "curly quotes");
    22	  });
    23	  test('no "not just X, but Y" framing', () => {
    24	    assert.doesNotMatch(prose, /\bnot just\b/i);
    25	  });
    26	  test("no unslop rule 7 vocabulary", () => {
    27	    for (const w of RULE7) assert.doesNotMatch(prose, new RegExp(`\\b${w}\\b`, "i"), w);
    28	  });
    29	  test("headings are sentence case", () => {
    30	    for (const line of prose.split("\n")) {
    31	      const m = line.match(/^#+\s+(.*)$/);
    32	      if (!m) continue;
    33	      const words = m[1].split(/\s+/).slice(1);
    34	      const capitalised = words.filter((w) => /^[A-Z][a-z]+/.test(w) && !HEADING_ALLOW.has(w.replace(/[^A-Za-z]/g, "")));
    35	      assert.equal(capitalised.length, 0, `title case heading: ${line}`);
    36	    }
    37	  });
    38	  test("no decorative emoji", () => {
    39	    assert.doesNotMatch(prose, /[\u{1F300}-\u{1FAFF}\u{2600}-\u{27BF}]/u);
    40	  });
    41	});

    45	  const lifecycle = read(...overlayDir, "20-lifecycle.md");

    48	    assert.match(precedence, /Other writing\./);

    56	      assert.equal(rows.length, 1, `row for ${id} ${name}`);

    78	    }

     1	import assert from "node:assert/strict";

     9	const config = (versions) => ({ plugins: Object.entries(versions).map(([name, version]) => ({ name, version })) });
    10	const byName = (results) => Object.fromEntries(results.map((r) => [r.name, r]));

    12	describe("semver comparison", () => {
    13	  test("compares numbers, not strings", () => {
    14	    assert.equal(compareSemver("0.10.0", "0.9.0"), 1);
    15	    assert.equal(compareSemver("0.9.0", "0.10.0"), -1);
    16	    assert.equal(compareSemver("1.0.0", "0.99.99"), 1);
    17	    assert.equal(compareSemver("0.2.10", "0.2.9"), 1);
    18	    assert.equal(compareSemver("0.3.0", "0.3.0"), 0);
    19	  });
    20	
    21	  test("a prerelease sorts before its release", () => {
    22	    assert.equal(compareSemver("1.0.0-rc.1", "1.0.0"), -1);
    23	    assert.equal(compareSemver("1.0.0", "1.0.0-rc.1"), 1);
    24	    assert.equal(compareSemver("1.0.0-rc.2", "1.0.0-rc.10"), -1);
    25	    assert.equal(compareSemver("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-beta"), -1);
    26	    assert.equal(compareSemver("1.0.0-1", "1.0.0-alpha"), -1);
    27	    assert.equal(compareSemver("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-alpha.1"), -1);
    28	  });
    29	
    30	  test("build metadata is ignored", () => {
    31	    assert.equal(compareSemver("1.0.0+build.2", "1.0.0+build.1"), 0);
    32	  });
    33	
    34	  test("rejects versions that are not semver", () => {
    35	    for (const bad of ["1.0", "v1.0.0", "01.0.0", "1.0.0-", "", null, undefined, 1]) assert.equal(parseSemver(bad), null, String(bad));
    36	    assert.throws(() => compareSemver("1.0", "1.0.0"), /not a semver version/);
    37	  });
    38	});

    40	describe("gate logic", () => {
    41	  test("changed files with a raised version pass", () => {
    42	    const [r] = evaluate({ head: config({ a: "0.3.1" }), base: config({ a: "0.3.0" }), changed: { a: ["plugins/a/x.md"] } });
    43	    assert.equal(r.ok, true);
    44	    assert.match(r.message, /0\.3\.0 -> 0\.3\.1/);
    45	  });
    46	
    47	  test("changed files without a version change fail", () => {
    48	    const [r] = evaluate({ head: config({ a: "0.3.0" }), base: config({ a: "0.3.0" }), changed: { a: ["plugins/a/x.md"] } });
    49	    assert.equal(r.ok, false);
    50	    assert.match(r.message, /must rise above 0\.3\.0/);
    51	  });
    52	
    53	  test("a lowered version fails", () => {
    54	    const [r] = evaluate({ head: config({ a: "0.2.9" }), base: config({ a: "0.3.0" }), changed: { a: ["plugins/a/x.md"] } });
    55	    assert.equal(r.ok, false);
    56	  });
    57	
    58	  test("0.10.0 counts as a raise over 0.9.0", () => {
    59	    const [r] = evaluate({ head: config({ a: "0.10.0" }), base: config({ a: "0.9.0" }), changed: { a: ["plugins/a/x.md"] } });
    60	    assert.equal(r.ok, true);
    61	  });
    62	
    63	  test("an unchanged plugin passes without a raise", () => {
    64	    const [r] = evaluate({ head: config({ a: "0.3.0" }), base: config({ a: "0.3.0" }), changed: {} });
    65	    assert.equal(r.ok, true);
    66	    assert.match(r.message, /no changes/);
    67	  });
    68	
    69	  test("a plugin absent at the base passes", () => {
    70	    const [r] = evaluate({ head: config({ a: "0.1.0" }), base: config({}), changed: { a: ["plugins/a/x.md"] } });
    71	    assert.equal(r.ok, true);
    72	    assert.match(r.message, /new plugin/);
    73	  });
    74	
    75	  test("a base without tools/plugins.json treats every plugin as new", () => {
    76	    const results = evaluate({ head: config({ a: "0.1.0", b: "0.1.0" }), base: null, changed: { a: ["plugins/a/x.md"], b: ["plugins/b/y.md"] } });
    77	    assert.deepEqual(results.map((r) => r.ok), [true, true]);
    78	  });
    79	
    80	  test("a version that is not semver fails when files changed", () => {
    81	    const [r] = evaluate({ head: config({ a: "0.4" }), base: config({ a: "0.3.0" }), changed: { a: ["plugins/a/x.md"] } });
    82	    assert.equal(r.ok, false);
    83	    assert.match(r.message, /not semver/);
    84	  });
    85	
    86	  test("each plugin is judged on its own files", () => {
    87	    const results = byName(evaluate({
    88	      head: config({ a: "0.3.1", b: "0.2.0", c: "0.2.0" }),
    89	      base: config({ a: "0.3.0", b: "0.2.0", c: "0.2.0" }),
    90	      changed: new Map([["a", ["plugins/a/x.md"]], ["b", ["plugins/b/y.md"]], ["c", []]]),
    91	    }));
    92	    assert.equal(results.a.ok, true);
    93	    assert.equal(results.b.ok, false);
    94	    assert.equal(results.c.ok, true);
    95	  });
    96	});

    98	// A local fixture repo, with no remote, to test the git plumbing.
    99	describe("gate on a fixture repo", () => {
   100	  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "adhd-unslop-gate-"));
   101	  after(() => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
   102	  const quiet = ["-c", "init.defaultBranch=main", "-c", "user.name=gate", "-c", "user.email=gate@example.invalid", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null"];
   103	  const git = (...args) => {
   104	    const r = spawnSync("git", [...quiet, ...args], { cwd: dir, encoding: "utf8" });
   105	    assert.equal(r.status, 0, `git ${args.join(" ")}: ${r.stderr}`);
   106	    return r.stdout;
   107	  };
   108	  const write = (rel, text) => {
   109	    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(dir, rel)), { recursive: true });
   110	    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, rel), text);
   111	  };
   112	  const writeConfig = (versions) => write("tools/plugins.json", JSON.stringify(config(versions), null, 2) + "\n");
   113	  const commit = (message) => {
   114	    git("add", "-A");
   115	    git("commit", "-q", "-m", message);
   116	  };
   117	
   118	  git("init", "-q");
   119	  write("README.md", "fixture\n");
   120	  commit("before plugins.json");
   121	  git("tag", "no-config");
   122	  writeConfig({ a: "0.1.0", b: "0.1.0" });
   123	  write("plugins/a/SKILL.md", "a\n");
   124	  write("plugins/b/SKILL.md", "b\n");
   125	  write("plugins/b/old.md", "old\n");
   126	  commit("base");
   127	
   128	  test("a change without a raise fails, and a raise passes", () => {
   129	    git("checkout", "-q", "-b", "no-raise", "main");
   130	    write("plugins/a/SKILL.md", "a changed\n");
   131	    commit("edit a");
   132	    const r1 = byName(gate({ base: "main", cwd: dir }).results);
   133	    assert.equal(r1.a.ok, false);
   134	    assert.equal(r1.b.ok, true);
   135	
   136	    writeConfig({ a: "0.1.1", b: "0.1.0" });
   137	    commit("raise a");
   138	    const r2 = byName(gate({ base: "main", cwd: dir }).results);
   139	    assert.equal(r2.a.ok, true);
   140	  });
   141	
   142	  test("a removed file counts as a change", () => {
   143	    git("checkout", "-q", "-b", "remove", "main");
   144	    fs.rmSync(path.join(dir, "plugins/b/old.md"));
   145	    commit("remove from b");
   146	    const { results, changed } = gate({ base: "main", cwd: dir });
   147	    assert.deepEqual(changed.get("b"), ["plugins/b/old.md"]);
   148	    assert.equal(byName(results).b.ok, false);
   149	  });
   150	
   151	  test("a change on the base after the branch point is not blamed on the branch", () => {
   152	    git("checkout", "-q", "-b", "side", "main");
   153	    write("NOTES.md", "unrelated\n");
   154	    commit("unrelated");
   155	    git("checkout", "-q", "main");
   156	    write("plugins/a/SKILL.md", "a changed on main\n");
   157	    writeConfig({ a: "0.2.0", b: "0.1.0" });
   158	    commit("main moves on");
   159	    git("checkout", "-q", "side");
   160	    const { results, changed } = gate({ base: "main", cwd: dir });
   161	    assert.deepEqual(changed.get("a"), []);
   162	    assert.equal(results.every((r) => r.ok), true);
   163	  });
   164	
   165	  test("a base with no tools/plugins.json passes a new plugin", () => {
   166	    git("checkout", "-q", "main");
   167	    const { results, baseHasConfig } = gate({ base: "no-config", cwd: dir });
   168	    assert.equal(baseHasConfig, false);
   169	    assert.equal(results.every((r) => r.ok), true);
   170	  });
   171	
   172	  test("an unknown base is an error", () => {
   173	    assert.throws(() => gate({ base: "does-not-exist", cwd: dir }), /not a commit/);
   174	  });

    11	const FLAG = ".adhd-unslop-always";
    12	const MIRRORS = ["au-i-have-adhd", "au-unslop"];

    15	// A throwaway home with empty Claude Code and Codex config dirs.
    16	function tempDirs() {
    17	  const base = trackTemp(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "adhd-unslop-doctor-")));
    18	  const home = path.join(base, "home");
    19	  const claude = path.join(home, ".claude");
    20	  const codex = path.join(home, ".codex");
    21	  for (const d of [claude, codex]) fs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true });
    22	  return { base, home, claude, codex };
    23	}
    24	
    25	// Copy whole generated plugin dirs so a test can break them.
    26	function copyPlugins(dest, names = ["adhd-unslop", ...MIRRORS]) {
    27	  for (const n of names) fs.cpSync(path.join(plugins, n), path.join(dest, n), { recursive: true });
    28	  return path.join(dest, "adhd-unslop");
    29	}
    30	
    31	function runDoctor(dirs, { root = path.join(plugins, "adhd-unslop"), env = {} } = {}) {
    32	  const clean = { PATH: process.env.PATH, HOME: dirs.home, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: dirs.claude, CODEX_HOME: dirs.codex, ...env };
    33	  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(clean)) if (v === undefined) delete clean[k];
    34	  const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, [path.join(root, SCRIPT)], { env: clean, encoding: "utf8" });
    35	  const lines = r.stdout.split("\n").filter(Boolean);
    36	  return {
    37	    ...r,
    38	    lines,
    39	    oks: lines.filter((l) => l.startsWith("OK   ")),
    40	    warns: lines.filter((l) => l.startsWith("WARN ")),
    41	    fails: lines.filter((l) => l.startsWith("FAIL ")),
    42	    has: (re) => lines.some((l) => re.test(l)),
    43	  };
    44	}
    45	
    46	// The line right after a WARN or FAIL line that matches `re`.
    47	function fixFor(r, re) {
    48	  const i = r.lines.findIndex((l) => /^(WARN|FAIL) /.test(l) && re.test(l));
    49	  assert.ok(i >= 0, `no WARN or FAIL line matching ${re}:\n${r.stdout}`);
    50	  assert.match(r.lines[i + 1] ?? "", /^ {5}fix: \S/);
    51	  return r.lines[i + 1];
    52	}
    53	
    54	function snapshot(dir) {
    55	  const out = [];
    56	  const walk = (d) => {
    57	    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    58	      const p = path.join(d, e.name);
    59	      const st = fs.lstatSync(p);
    60	      out.push(`${path.relative(dir, p)} ${st.size} ${st.mtimeMs}`);
    61	      if (e.isDirectory()) walk(p);
    62	    }
    63	  };
    64	  walk(dir);
    65	  return out.sort();
    66	}

    23	    steps:
    24	      # create-pull-request sets up its own git credentials from its token.
    25	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
    26	        with:

    29	        with:
    30	          node-version: 22
    31	
    32	      # Refetches every pinned file at its pinned commit and compares hashes.
    33	      # A mismatch skips the bump and opens the issue with the mismatch.
    34	      - name: Verify the pins against upstream
    35	        id: verify
    36	        continue-on-error: true
    37	        env:
    38	          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    39	        run: |
    40	          if node tools/sync.mjs --verify-remote > "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify.log" 2>&1; then
    41	            cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify.log"
    42	          else
    43	            cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify.log"
    44	            {
    45	              echo "# Pinned upstream files do not match upstream"
    46	              echo
    47	              echo "\`sync.mjs --verify-remote\` refetched each pinned file at its pinned commit. These files differ from the sha256 in \`tools/upstream.json\`, so the bump did not run."
    48	              echo
    49	              echo '```'
    50	              cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/verify.log"
    51	              echo '```'
    52	            } > "$RUNNER_TEMP/report.md"
    53	            exit 1
    54	          fi
    55	
    56	      # Exits 1 when a bump fails its checks. Successful bumps are kept either way.
    57	      - name: Check upstreams and bump
    58	        id: sync
    59	        if: steps.verify.outcome == 'success'
    60	        continue-on-error: true
    61	        env:
    62	          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    63	        run: node tools/sync.mjs --latest --report "$RUNNER_TEMP/report.md"
    64	
    65	      - name: Open or update the bump PR
    66	        id: pr
    67	        if: steps.verify.outcome == 'success'
    68	        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@5f6978faf089d4d20b00c7766989d076bb2fc7f1 # v8.1.1
    69	        with:
    70	          branch: upstream-bump
    71	          delete-branch: true
    72	          commit-message: Bump upstream skills
    73	          title: Bump upstream skills
    74	          body-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/report.md
    75	          add-paths: |
    76	            upstream/**
    77	            tools/upstream.json
    78	            tools/plugins.json
    79	            plugins/**
    80	            .claude-plugin/**
    81	            .agents/plugins/**
    82	
    83	      # A PR opened with GITHUB_TOKEN does not trigger push or pull_request
    84	      # workflows, but GITHUB_TOKEN may start a workflow_dispatch run.
    85	      - name: Verify the PR branch
    86	        if: steps.pr.outputs.pull-request-operation == 'created' || steps.pr.outputs.pull-request-operation == 'updated'
    87	        env:
    88	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    89	        run: gh workflow run verify.yml --ref upstream-bump
    90

    96	          title="Upstream bump needs attention"

    98	          if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
    99	            gh issue comment "$existing" --body-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/report.md"
   100	          else
   101	            gh issue create --title "$title" --body-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/report.md"
   102	          fi

     1	#!/usr/bin/env node
     2	// Install this marketplace with the real Claude Code and Codex CLIs, with no
     3	// keys and no sign-in, and check what each CLI loads. No model runs.
     4	//
     5	//   node tools/load-check.mjs [--claude <bin>] [--codex <bin>] [--only claude|codex] [--repo <path>]
     6	//
     7	// The repo's tracked and untracked-not-ignored files are copied into a fresh
     8	// git repo in a temp dir, which serves as the marketplace, so no CLI writes
     9	// into the working tree. Every CLI runs in throwaway homes that are deleted at
    10	// the end. Expected names, versions, and hook keys come from
    11	// tools/plugins.json and the generated plugins/*/hooks/hooks.json.
    12	//
    13	// Step one installs the authored plugins only and asserts that nothing else
    14	// comes with them. Step two installs the vendored plugins by name. Codex also
    15	// gets a catalog check through `codex app-server` (plugin/list, plugin/read,
    16	// hooks/list). Prints PASS and FAIL lines and exits 1 on any failure.

    31	function parseArgs(argv) {
    32	  const opts = {
    33	    claude: "claude",
    34	    codex: "codex",
    35	    only: null,
    36	    repo: path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), ".."),
    37	  };
    38	  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
    39	    const arg = argv[i];
    40	    const value = () => {
    41	      if (i + 1 >= argv.length) usage(`${arg} needs a value`);
    42	      return argv[++i];
    43	    };
    44	    if (arg === "--claude") opts.claude = value();
    45	    else if (arg === "--codex") opts.codex = value();
    46	    else if (arg === "--repo") opts.repo = value();
    47	    else if (arg === "--only") {
    48	      opts.only = value();
    49	      if (!["claude", "codex"].includes(opts.only)) usage(`--only takes claude or codex, not ${opts.only}`);
    50	    } else if (arg === "-h" || arg === "--help") usage();
    51	    else usage(`unknown argument ${arg}`);
    52	  }
    53	  opts.repo = path.resolve(opts.repo);
    54	  return opts;
    55	}

    73	function fail(name, detail) {
    74	  failed++;
    75	  console.log(`FAIL  ${name}`);
    76	  if (detail) for (const line of String(detail).trimEnd().split("\n")) console.log(`      ${line}`);

    79	function check(name, ok, detail) {
    80	  if (ok) pass(name);
    81	  else fail(name, typeof detail === "function" ? detail() : detail);
    82	  return ok;
    83	}

    97	function cleanup() {
    98	  for (const child of children) {
    99	    try { child.kill("SIGKILL"); } catch { /* already gone */ }
   100	  }
   101	  // Codex writes shell snapshots with environment variables into CODEX_HOME.
   102	  for (const dir of tempRoots.splice(0)) fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
   103	}
   104	
   105	process.on("exit", cleanup);
   106	for (const signal of ["SIGINT", "SIGTERM"]) process.on(signal, () => process.exit(130));

   123	// Every CLI call except the app-server gets stdin from /dev/null.
   124	function run(bin, args, { env, cwd, timeout = CLI_TIMEOUT_MS } = {}) {
   125	  const r = spawnSync(bin, args, { env, cwd, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"], encoding: "utf8", timeout, maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024 });
   126	  const output = `${r.stdout ?? ""}${r.stderr ?? ""}`;
   127	  let problem = null;
   128	  if (r.error) problem = r.error.code === "ETIMEDOUT" ? `timed out after ${timeout / 1000}s` : r.error.message;
   129	  else if (r.status !== 0) problem = `exit ${r.status ?? r.signal}`;
   130	  return { ok: !problem, problem, stdout: r.stdout ?? "", output };
   131	}
   132	
   133	// Run a CLI step that later steps depend on. PASS or FAIL, and abort on FAIL.
   134	function step(name, bin, args, opts) {
   135	  const r = run(bin, args, opts);
   136	  const cmd = [path.basename(bin), ...args].join(" ");
   137	  if (!check(name, r.ok, () => `$ ${cmd}\n${r.problem}\n${tail(r.output)}`)) throw new Abort(name);
   138	  return r;
   139	}
   140	
   141	function git(cwd, args) {
   142	  const r = spawnSync("git", args, { cwd, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"], encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024 });
   143	  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(" ")} failed: ${r.error?.message ?? tail(r.stderr)}`);
   144	  return r.stdout;
   145	}

   147	function cliVersion(bin, env) {
   148	  const r = run(bin, ["--version"], { env, timeout: 60_000 });
   149	  return r.ok ? r.stdout.trim() : `unavailable (${r.problem})`;
   150	}

   154	// Tracked plus untracked-not-ignored files, as tests/e2e/run.sh copies them.
   155	// Index entries deleted from the working tree are skipped.
   156	function copyRepo(repo, dest) {
   157	  const files = git(repo, ["ls-files", "-co", "--exclude-standard", "-z"]).split("\0").filter(Boolean);
   158	  fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });
   159	  let copied = 0;
   160	  for (const rel of new Set(files)) {
   161	    const src = path.join(repo, rel);
   162	    let stat;
   163	    try { stat = fs.lstatSync(src); } catch { continue; }
   164	    const out = path.join(dest, rel);
   165	    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
   166	    if (stat.isSymbolicLink()) fs.symlinkSync(fs.readlinkSync(src), out);
   167	    else if (stat.isFile()) fs.copyFileSync(src, out);
   168	    else continue;
   169	    copied++;
   170	  }
   171	  const quiet = ["-c", "init.defaultBranch=main", "-c", "user.name=load-check", "-c", "user.email=load-check@example.invalid", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null"];
   172	  git(dest, [...quiet, "init", "-q"]);
   173	  git(dest, [...quiet, "add", "-A"]);
   174	  git(dest, [...quiet, "commit", "-q", "--no-verify", "-m", "load-check"]);
   175	  return copied;
   176	}

   180	const snake = (event) => event.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1_$2").toLowerCase();
   181	
   182	function listFiles(dir) {
   183	  const out = [];
   184	  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return out;
   185	  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
   186	    const abs = path.join(dir, entry.name);
   187	    if (entry.isDirectory()) out.push(...listFiles(abs));
   188	    else out.push(abs);
   189	  }
   190	  return out;
   191	}

   193	function expectations(copy) {
   194	  const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(copy, "tools", "plugins.json"), "utf8"));
   195	  const mkt = config.marketplace.name;
   196	  const plugins = config.plugins.map((p) => {
   197	    const root = path.join(copy, "plugins", p.name);
   198	    const skills = p.kind === "vendored" ? [p.skill] : Object.keys(p.skills ?? {});
   199	    const required = [];
   200	    for (const skill of skills) required.push(`skills/${skill}/SKILL.md`);
   201	    // The hooks file Codex reads, as the Codex manifest names it, relative to the plugin root.
   202	    let hooksFile = "hooks/hooks.json";
   203	    try {
   204	      const codexManifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, ".codex-plugin", "plugin.json"), "utf8"));
   205	      if (typeof codexManifest.hooks === "string") hooksFile = codexManifest.hooks.replace(/^\.\//, "");
   206	    } catch { /* checked by the install steps */ }
   207	    const hookKeys = [];
   208	    const hooksPath = path.join(root, hooksFile);
   209	    if (fs.existsSync(hooksPath)) {
   210	      required.push(hooksFile);
   211	      const hooks = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(hooksPath, "utf8")).hooks ?? {};
   212	      for (const [event, groups] of Object.entries(hooks)) {
   213	        groups.forEach((group, g) => (group.hooks ?? []).forEach((_, h) => hookKeys.push(`${p.name}@${mkt}:${hooksFile}:${snake(event)}:${g}:${h}`)));
   214	      }
   215	    }
   216	    if (p.alwaysOn) {
   217	      required.push("hooks/chunks/manifest.json");
   218	      p.alwaysOn.forEach((_, i) => required.push(`hooks/chunks/${i + 1}.md`));
   219	    }
   220	    const sourceFiles = listFiles(root).map((abs) => path.relative(root, abs).split(path.sep).join("/"));
   221	    return {
   222	      name: p.name,
   223	      id: `${p.name}@${mkt}`,
   224	      kind: p.kind,
   225	      version: p.version,
   226	      skills,
   227	      fullSkills: skills.map((s) => `${p.name}:${s}`),
   228	      displayName: p.codexInterface?.displayName ?? null,
   229	      root,
   230	      required,
   231	      sourceFiles,
   232	      hooksFile,
   233	      hookKeys,
   234	    };
   235	  });
   236	  return { mkt, plugins };
   237	}

   243	// <cache>/<mkt>/ holds exactly the installed plugins, each with one version folder.
   244	function checkCacheLayout(label, mktCache, installed) {
   245	  const names = dirNames(mktCache);
   246	  check(`${label}: cache ${path.basename(mktCache)}/ holds only ${show(installed.map((p) => p.name))}`, sameSet(names, installed.map((p) => p.name)), `found: ${show(names)}`);
   247	  for (const p of installed) {
   248	    const versions = dirNames(path.join(mktCache, p.name));
   249	    check(`${label}: cache ${p.name}/ holds only ${p.version}/`, sameSet(versions, [p.version]), `found: ${show(versions)}`);
   250	  }
   251	}

   253	// The installed copy has the required files, and every shipped file byte for byte.
   254	// Extra files are allowed, so a CLI that adds metadata does not fail the check.
   255	function checkInstalledFiles(label, p, dir) {
   256	  const missing = p.required.filter((rel) => !fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, rel)));
   257	  check(`${label}: ${p.name} install has ${p.required.length} required files`, missing.length === 0, `missing under ${dir}:\n${missing.join("\n")}`);
   258	  const differ = p.sourceFiles.filter((rel) => {
   259	    const out = path.join(dir, rel);
   260	    return !fs.existsSync(out) || !fs.readFileSync(out).equals(fs.readFileSync(path.join(p.root, rel)));
   261	  });
   262	  check(`${label}: ${p.name} install matches all ${p.sourceFiles.length} shipped files`, p.sourceFiles.length > 0 && differ.length === 0, `missing or different under ${dir}:\n${differ.join("\n") || "(no shipped files found)"}`);
   263	}

   267	function parseJson(text, what) {
   268	  const trimmed = text.trim();
   269	  const start = [trimmed.indexOf("["), trimmed.indexOf("{")].filter((i) => i >= 0).sort((a, b) => a - b)[0];
   270	  try {
   271	    return JSON.parse(start > 0 ? trimmed.slice(start) : trimmed);
   272	  } catch (err) {
   273	    throw new Error(`${what}: not JSON (${err.message}):\n${tail(text)}`);
   274	  }
   275	}

   277	function claudeList(bin, opts, label) {
   278	  const r = step(`${label}: claude plugin list --json`, bin, ["plugin", "list", "--json"], opts);
   279	  const list = parseJson(r.stdout, "claude plugin list --json");
   280	  if (!Array.isArray(list)) throw new Error(`claude plugin list --json: expected an array, got ${typeof list}`);
   281	  return list;
   282	}

   284	function checkClaudeInstalled(label, list, expected, mkt, configDir) {

   286	  check(`${label}: installed from ${mkt}: exactly ${show(expected.map((p) => p.name))}`, sameSet(ours.map((e) => e.id), expected.map((p) => p.id)), `installed: ${show(ours.map((e) => e.id))}`);

   293	    check(`${label}: ${p.id} is enabled`, entry.enabled !== false, `enabled: ${entry.enabled}`);
   294	    const expectedPath = path.join(configDir, "plugins", "cache", mkt, p.name, p.version);
   295	    check(`${label}: ${p.id} installPath is the versioned cache copy`, path.resolve(entry.installPath ?? "") === expectedPath, `installPath: ${entry.installPath}\nexpected:    ${expectedPath}`);
   296	    if (entry.installPath) checkInstalledFiles(label, p, entry.installPath);
   297	  }
   298	  checkCacheLayout(label, path.join(configDir, "plugins", "cache", mkt), expected);
   299	}

   329	// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Codex app-server
   330	
   331	function startAppServer(bin, { cwd, env }) {
   332	  const child = spawn(bin, ["app-server", "--listen", "stdio://"], { cwd, env, stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"] });
   333	  children.add(child);
   334	  let stderr = "";
   335	  let exited = null;
   336	  let nextId = 0;
   337	  const pending = new Map();
   338	  const rejectAll = (err) => {
   339	    for (const { reject, timer } of pending.values()) {
   340	      clearTimeout(timer);
   341	      reject(err);
   342	    }
   343	    pending.clear();
   344	  };
   345	  // Drain stderr so a full pipe never blocks the server.
   346	  child.stderr.on("data", (d) => {
   347	    stderr = (stderr + d).slice(-20_000);
   348	  });
   349	  child.stdin.on("error", () => { /* reported through exit */ });
   350	  child.on("error", (err) => {
   351	    exited = { error: err };
   352	    rejectAll(new Error(`app-server failed to start: ${err.message}`));
   353	  });
   354	  child.on("exit", (code, signal) => {
   355	    exited = { code, signal };
   356	    children.delete(child);
   357	    rejectAll(new Error(`app-server exited (${code ?? signal})\n${tail(stderr)}`));
   358	  });
   359	  // One JSON object per line. Responses carry an id and no method; notifications
   360	  // and server requests are ignored.
   361	  readline.createInterface({ input: child.stdout }).on("line", (line) => {
   362	    line = line.trim();
   363	    if (!line.startsWith("{")) return;
   364	    let msg;
   365	    try { msg = JSON.parse(line); } catch { return; }
   366	    if (msg.method !== undefined || !pending.has(msg.id)) return;
   367	    const { resolve, timer } = pending.get(msg.id);
   368	    pending.delete(msg.id);
   369	    clearTimeout(timer);
   370	    resolve(msg);
   371	  });
   372	
   373	  const send = (msg) => child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", ...msg }) + "\n");
   374	  return {
   375	    request(method, params, timeout = RPC_TIMEOUT_MS) {
   376	      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   377	        if (exited) return reject(new Error(`app-server is not running (${JSON.stringify(exited)})\n${tail(stderr)}`));
   378	        const id = ++nextId;
   379	        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
   380	          pending.delete(id);
   381	          reject(new Error(`${method} timed out after ${timeout / 1000}s\n${tail(stderr)}`));
   382	        }, timeout);
   383	        pending.set(id, { resolve, reject, timer });
   384	        send({ id, method, params });
   385	      });
   386	    },
   387	    notify(method, params) {
   388	      send(params === undefined ? { method } : { method, params });
   389	    },
   390	    async close() {
   391	      if (exited) return;
   392	      const done = new Promise((resolve) => child.once("exit", resolve));
   393	      child.stdin.end();
   394	      child.kill("SIGTERM");
   395	      const timer = setTimeout(() => child.kill("SIGKILL"), 3000);
   396	      await done;
   397	      clearTimeout(timer);
   398	    },
   399	  };
   400	}
   401	
   402	async function rpc(server, label, method, params, what = method) {
   403	  let msg;
   404	  try {
   405	    msg = await server.request(method, params);
   406	  } catch (err) {
   407	    fail(`${label}: ${what}`, err.message);
   408	    throw new Abort(what);
   409	  }
   410	  if (!check(`${label}: ${what} succeeds`, !msg.error, () => JSON.stringify(msg.error, null, 2))) throw new Abort(what);
   411	  return msg.result ?? {};
   412	}

   414	async function codexCatalog(bin, copy, exp, env, label) {
   415	  const server = startAppServer(bin, { cwd: copy, env });
   416	  try {
   417	    await rpc(server, label, "initialize", {
   418	      clientInfo: { name: "adhd-unslop-load-check", title: "adhd-unslop load check", version: "0" },
   419	      capabilities: { experimentalApi: true, requestAttestation: false, optOutNotificationMethods: [] },
   420	    });
   421	    server.notify("initialized");
   422	
   423	    // plugin/list: one local marketplace with this name, read from the Codex file.
   424	    const listed = await rpc(server, label, "plugin/list", { cwds: [copy], marketplaceKinds: ["local"] });
   425	    const loadErrors = listed.marketplaceLoadErrors ?? [];
   426	    check(`${label}: plugin/list reports no marketplaceLoadErrors`, loadErrors.length === 0, JSON.stringify(loadErrors, null, 2));
   427	    const ours = (listed.marketplaces ?? []).filter((m) => m.name === exp.mkt);
   428	    check(`${label}: plugin/list shows exactly one marketplace named ${exp.mkt}`, ours.length === 1, `found ${ours.length}: ${JSON.stringify(ours.map((m) => m.path))}`);
   429	    const codexMarketplace = path.join(copy, ".agents", "plugins", "marketplace.json");
   430	    if (ours.length === 1) {
   431	      check(`${label}: ${exp.mkt} is read from .agents/plugins/marketplace.json`, path.resolve(ours[0].path ?? "") === codexMarketplace, `path: ${ours[0].path}`);
   432	      const names = (ours[0].plugins ?? []).map((p) => p.name);
   433	      check(`${label}: ${exp.mkt} lists ${show(exp.plugins.map((p) => p.name))}`, sameSet(names, exp.plugins.map((p) => p.name)), `listed: ${show(names)}`);
   434	    }
   435	
   436	    // plugin/read reads the marketplace entry, installed or not.
   437	    for (const p of exp.plugins) {
   438	      let plugin;
   439	      try {
   440	        plugin = (await rpc(server, label, "plugin/read", { marketplacePath: codexMarketplace, remoteMarketplaceName: null, pluginName: p.name }, `plugin/read ${p.name}`)).plugin ?? {};
   441	      } catch (err) {
   442	        if (err instanceof Abort) continue;
   443	        throw err;
   444	      }
   445	      const skills = (plugin.skills ?? []).map((s) => s.name);
   446	      check(`${label}: ${p.name} skills are ${show(p.fullSkills)}`, skills.length > 0 && sameSet(skills, p.fullSkills), `read: ${show(skills)}`);
   447	      const hooks = (plugin.hooks ?? []).map((h) => h.key);
   448	      check(`${label}: ${p.name} hook keys are ${p.hookKeys.length ? p.hookKeys.map((k) => k.split(":").slice(-2).join(":")).join(" ") : "none"}`, sameSet(hooks, p.hookKeys), `read: ${show(hooks)}\nexpected: ${show(p.hookKeys)}`);
   449	      const version = plugin.summary?.localVersion;
   450	      check(`${label}: ${p.name} version ${p.version}`, version === p.version, `localVersion: ${version}`);
   451	      const displayName = plugin.summary?.interface?.displayName ?? null;
   452	      check(`${label}: ${p.name} interface.displayName from .codex-plugin`, displayName === p.displayName, `displayName: ${JSON.stringify(displayName)}, expected ${JSON.stringify(p.displayName)}`);
   453	    }
   454	
   455	    // hooks/list reports the installed plugins' hooks, from the cache copy.
   456	    const hookList = await rpc(server, label, "hooks/list", { cwds: [copy] });
   457	    const entries = hookList.data ?? [];
   458	    const problems = entries.flatMap((e) => [...(e.warnings ?? []), ...(e.errors ?? [])]);
   459	    check(`${label}: hooks/list reports no warnings or errors`, problems.length === 0, JSON.stringify(problems, null, 2));
   460	    const all = new Map();
   461	    for (const e of entries) for (const h of e.hooks ?? []) all.set(h.key, h);
   462	    const listedHooks = [...all.values()].filter((h) => String(h.pluginId ?? "").endsWith(`@${exp.mkt}`));
   463	    for (const p of exp.plugins) {
   464	      const mine = listedHooks.filter((h) => h.pluginId === p.id);
   465	      check(`${label}: hooks/list for ${p.name}: ${p.hookKeys.length ? p.hookKeys.map((k) => k.split(":").slice(-2).join(":")).join(" ") : "none"}`, sameSet(mine.map((h) => h.key), p.hookKeys), `listed: ${show(mine.map((h) => h.key))}\nexpected: ${show(p.hookKeys)}`);
   466	      if (!mine.length) continue;
   467	      const suffix = ["plugins", "cache", exp.mkt, p.name, p.version, ...p.hooksFile.split("/")].join(path.sep);
   468	      const wrong = mine.filter((h) => !path.resolve(h.sourcePath ?? "").endsWith(path.sep + suffix));
   469	      check(`${label}: hooks/list for ${p.name} reads the ${p.version} cache copy`, wrong.length === 0, wrong.map((h) => `${h.key}: ${h.sourcePath}`).join("\n"));
   470	      const unhashed = mine.filter((h) => !/^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(h.currentHash ?? ""));
   471	      check(`${label}: hooks/list for ${p.name} gives each handler a trust hash`, unhashed.length === 0, unhashed.map((h) => `${h.key}: ${h.currentHash}`).join("\n"));
   472	      console.log(`      trust: ${mine.map((h) => `${h.key.split(":").slice(-2).join(":")}=${h.trustStatus}`).join(" ")}`);
   473	    }
   474	  } finally {
   475	    await server.close();
   476	  }
   477	}

   481	async function runCodex(bin, copy, exp, tmp) {
   482	  const home = path.join(tmp, "codex-home");
   483	  const codexHome = path.join(tmp, "codex-config");
   484	  fs.mkdirSync(home, { recursive: true });
   485	  fs.mkdirSync(codexHome, { recursive: true });
   486	  const env = baseEnv({ HOME: home, USERPROFILE: home, CODEX_HOME: codexHome, CODEX_APP_SERVER_DISABLE_MANAGED_CONFIG: "1", RUST_LOG: "warn" });
   487	  const opts = { env, cwd: copy };
   488	  console.log(`codex: ${cliVersion(bin, env)}`);
   489	
   490	  const cache = path.join(codexHome, "plugins", "cache", exp.mkt);
   491	  const checkCodexInstalled = (label, installed) => {
   492	    checkCacheLayout(label, cache, installed);
   493	    for (const p of installed) {
   494	      const dir = path.join(cache, p.name, p.version);
   495	      if (fs.existsSync(dir)) checkInstalledFiles(label, p, dir);
   496	    }
   497	  };
   498	  const first = exp.plugins.filter((p) => p.kind === "authored");
   499	  const second = exp.plugins.filter((p) => p.kind !== "authored");
   500	  try {
   501	    step("codex: plugin marketplace add <copy>", bin, ["plugin", "marketplace", "add", copy], opts);
   502	    for (const p of first) step(`codex: plugin add ${p.id}`, bin, ["plugin", "add", p.id], opts);
   503	    checkCodexInstalled("codex step 1", first);
   504	
   505	    for (const p of second) step(`codex: plugin add ${p.id}`, bin, ["plugin", "add", p.id], opts);
   506	    checkCodexInstalled("codex step 2", exp.plugins);
   507	
   508	    await codexCatalog(bin, copy, exp, env, "codex catalog");
   509	  } catch (err) {
   510	    if (!(err instanceof Abort)) fail("codex: unexpected error", err.stack ?? err.message);
   511	  }
   512	}

   514	// ---------------------------------------------------------------- main
   515	
   516	async function main() {
   517	  const opts = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
   518	  const tmp = makeTempRoot();
   519	  const copy = path.join(tmp, "marketplace");
   520	  const count = copyRepo(opts.repo, copy);
   521	  console.log(`marketplace copy: ${count} files from ${opts.repo}`);
   522	  const exp = expectations(copy);
   523	  if (!exp.plugins.length) fail("tools/plugins.json lists plugins", "no plugins found");
   524	  if (!exp.plugins.some((p) => p.kind === "authored")) fail("tools/plugins.json lists an authored plugin", "step one would install nothing");
   525	
   526	  if (opts.only !== "codex") runClaude(opts.claude, copy, exp, tmp);
   527	  if (opts.only !== "claude") await runCodex(opts.codex, copy, exp, tmp);
   528	
   529	  console.log(`\n${passed} passed, ${failed} failed`);
   530	  process.exitCode = failed ? 1 : 0;
   531	}
   532	
   533	main().catch((err) => {
   534	  console.error(err.stack ?? err.message);
   535	  process.exitCode = 1;
   536	});

+name: CLI drift
+
+# The load check from verify.yml, against the latest Claude Code and Codex
+# releases instead of the pins in tools/cli-versions.json.
+# - A failure opens or updates one issue.
+# - A pass on newer releases opens or updates one PR that raises the pins.
+# The latest CLIs run in a read-only job. The jobs that write run no CLI.
+
+on:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: "23 7 * * *"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions: {}
+
+concurrency:
+  group: cli-drift
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  drift:
+    name: Load in the latest Claude Code and Codex
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    permissions:
+      contents: read # check out the repo
+    env:
+      DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER: "1"
+    outputs:
+      claude: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.claude }}
+      codex: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.codex }}
+      report: ${{ steps.report.outputs.report }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
+        with:
+          node-version: 22
+      - name: Install the latest CLIs
+        id: install
+        continue-on-error: true
+        # The CLIs under test, not build dependencies, so there is no lockfile.
+        run: | # zizmor: ignore[adhoc-packages]
+          npm install --global --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli" \
+            "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest" \
+            "@openai/codex@latest"
+          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/cli/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+
+      - name: Read the installed versions
+        id: versions
+        if: steps.install.outcome == 'success'
+        run: |
+          echo "claude=$(claude --version | awk '{print $1}')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "codex=$(codex --version </dev/null | awk '{print $NF}')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Run the load check
+        id: load
+        if: steps.install.outcome == 'success'
+        continue-on-error: true
+        run: |
+          set -o pipefail
+          node tools/load-check.mjs 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/load-check.log"
+
+      - name: Write the report
+        id: report
+        if: always()
+        env:
+          INSTALL: ${{ steps.install.outcome }}
+          LOAD: ${{ steps.load.outcome }}
+        run: |
+          log="$RUNNER_TEMP/load-check.log"
+          touch "$log"
+          {
+            echo '```'
+            grep -E '^(claude|codex): ' "$log" || echo "no CLI versions printed"
+            echo
+            # Each FAIL line with its indented detail lines.
+            awk '/^FAIL/ { keep = 1; print; next } /^      / { if (keep) print; next } { keep = 0 }' "$log" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/fails.txt"
+            if [ "$INSTALL" != "success" ]; then
+              echo "Installing the latest CLIs failed. See the run log."
+            elif [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/fails.txt" ]; then
+              cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/fails.txt"
+            elif [ "$LOAD" = "failure" ]; then
+              tail -n 40 "$log"
+            else
+              grep -E 'passed, ' "$log" || echo "passed"
+            fi
+            echo '```'
+          } > "$RUNNER_TEMP/report.md"
+          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/report.md" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          {
+            echo "report<<ADHD_UNSLOP_EOF"
+            cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/report.md"
+            echo "ADHD_UNSLOP_EOF"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Fail the job
+        if: steps.install.outcome != 'success' || steps.load.outcome != 'success'
+        run: exit 1
+
+  issue:
+    name: Open or update the drift issue
+    needs: drift
+    if: always() && needs.drift.result == 'failure'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions:
+      issues: write # open or comment on the drift issue
+    steps:
+      - name: Open or update the drift issue
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
+          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
+          REPORT: ${{ needs.drift.outputs.report }}
+        run: |

+// SessionStart hook launcher. Prints one chunk of the adhd-unslop rules when
+// the user has opted in: a flag file at $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.adhd-unslop-always
+// or $CODEX_HOME/.adhd-unslop-always, or ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS=1. ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS=0
+// turns it off even when a flag exists.
+//
+// Selected by ADHD_UNSLOP_CHUNK=1|2|3, set by each handler in hooks/hooks.json.
+// Prints nothing on a Claude Code resume, which keeps the earlier copy.
+// Never blocks session start: every path exits 0. With opt-in present and a
+// broken installation, prints one JSON systemMessage and no context.
+
+import path from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+import { flagPaths, optedIn, readHookInput, renderChunk, runtimeOf, shouldInject } from "./lib.mjs";
+
+async function main() {
+  if (!optedIn()) return;
+  const input = await readHookInput();
+  if (!shouldInject(input?.source, runtimeOf())) return;
+  const root = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
+  const index = Number.parseInt(process.env.ADHD_UNSLOP_CHUNK ?? "", 10);
+  const result = renderChunk(root, index, { flags: flagPaths() });
+  if (result.ok) {
+    process.stdout.write(result.text);
+  } else {
+    process.stdout.write(
+      JSON.stringify({ systemMessage: `adhd-unslop always-on: ${result.reason}. Reinstall or rebuild the plugin.` }) + "\n",
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+main()
+  .catch(() => {
+    // Never block session start.
+  })
+  .finally(() => process.exit(0));

index 0000000..dad9b64

+// Shared helpers for the build, the always-on launcher, and the tests.
+// No dependencies. Runs on Node 18 or later.
+
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+import fs from "node:fs";
+import os from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+
+export const TOTAL_CHUNKS = 3;
+export const FLAG_NAME = ".adhd-unslop-always";
+// Claude Code caps each hook context value at 10,000 characters.
+export const MAX_CHARS = 10000;
+// Codex allows about 2,500 tokens per handler by default; hooks.json sets 5000.
+export const DEFAULT_TOKEN_LIMIT = 5000;
+export const BUNDLE_ID_LENGTH = 12;
+
+export function sha256(text) {
+  return createHash("sha256").update(Buffer.from(text, "utf8")).digest("hex");
+}
+
+// One estimate for everything: ceil(UTF-16 code units / 4).
+export function estimateTokens(text) {
+  return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);
+}
+
+export function stripFrontmatter(text) {
+  return text.replace(/^---[^\S\r\n]*\r?\n[\s\S]*?\r?\n---[^\S\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|$)/, "");
+}
+
+export function flagPaths(env = process.env, home = os.homedir()) {
+  const claudeDir = env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR || path.join(home, ".claude");
+  const codexDir = env.CODEX_HOME || path.join(home, ".codex");
+  return [path.join(claudeDir, FLAG_NAME), path.join(codexDir, FLAG_NAME)];
+}
+
+// ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS overrides the flag files for one process.
+// Unset or empty: the flag files decide. 0, false, off: off. 1, true, on: on.
+// Any other value counts as unset, and the doctor reports it.
+export function alwaysOnSetting(env = process.env) {
+  const raw = env.ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS;
+  if (raw === undefined || raw === "") return { mode: "unset", raw };
+  const value = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
+  if (["0", "false", "off"].includes(value)) return { mode: "off", raw };
+  if (["1", "true", "on"].includes(value)) return { mode: "on", raw };
+  return { mode: "invalid", raw };
+}
+
+export function flagExists(env = process.env, home = os.homedir()) {
+  return flagPaths(env, home).some((p) => {
+    try {
+      return fs.statSync(p).isFile();
+    } catch {
+      return false;
+    }
+  });
+}
+
+export function optedIn(env = process.env, home = os.homedir()) {
+  const { mode } = alwaysOnSetting(env);
+  if (mode === "off") return false;
+  if (mode === "on") return true;
+  return flagExists(env, home);
+}
+
+// Codex sets PLUGIN_ROOT for plugin hooks and Claude Code never does
+// (design/research/10-tests-hook-env.md). Returns "codex", "claude", or null.
+export function runtimeOf(env = process.env) {
+  if (env.PLUGIN_ROOT) return "codex";
+  if (env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) return "claude";
+  return null;
+}
+
+// Claude Code keeps the earlier injection in a resumed session, so a resume
+// would add a second copy. Codex can resume with no copy after a compaction,
+// so it keeps injecting on resume (design/STRUCTURE-v2.md P3). An unknown
+// runtime or source injects.
+export function shouldInject(source, runtime) {
+  return !(source === "resume" && runtime === "claude");
+}
+
+// Read the SessionStart payload from stdin. Resolves to the parsed object, or
+// null when stdin is a TTY, empty, invalid, or silent for timeoutMs.
+export function readHookInput(stream = process.stdin, timeoutMs = 1000) {
+  return new Promise((resolve) => {
+    if (!stream || stream.isTTY) {
+      resolve(null);
+      return;
+    }
+    let data = "";
+    let done = false;
+    const finish = () => {
+      if (done) return;
+      done = true;
+      clearTimeout(timer);
+      try {
+        resolve(data.trim() ? JSON.parse(data) : null);
+      } catch {
+        resolve(null);
+      }
+    };
+    const timer = setTimeout(finish, timeoutMs);
+    stream.setEncoding("utf8");
+    stream.on("data", (chunk) => {
+      data += chunk;
+    });
+    stream.on("end", finish);
+    stream.on("error", finish);
+  });
+}
+
+export function bundleId(compositeSha) {
+  return compositeSha.slice(0, BUNDLE_ID_LENGTH);
+}
+
+export function chunkHeader(index, id) {
+  return [
+    `ADHD-UNSLOP INSTRUCTIONS. Chunk ${index} of ${TOTAL_CHUNKS} from bundle ${id}.`,
+    `These instructions come from the adhd-unslop always-on hook, which the user turned on. A bundle is complete when all ${TOTAL_CHUNKS} chunks with the same bundle id are present, each ending with its END line. Until a bundle is complete, the previously selected complete bundle and the current mode states stay in effect, the missing chunk is named once, and nothing activates from the partial set.`,
+    "A repeated chunk with the same bundle id and index is a repeat, not a new activation. Chunks from different bundle ids are never combined. A newly completed bundle replaces its rules without resetting mode states. Chunks from an older bundle do not select that bundle again.",
+    "Receiving instructions does not change mode state. The latest known state of the ADHD mode and the unslop mode in this session stays in effect. Once a complete bundle is available, each unknown mode defaults to active.",
+    "Precedence. On a direct reply ADHD wins a conflict. Elsewhere unslop wins.",
+    "",
+  ].join("\n");
+}
+
+export function chunkFooter(index, id, flags) {
+  return [
+    "",
+    `END adhd-unslop chunk ${index} of ${TOTAL_CHUNKS} (${id}). Always-on stops when every opt-in flag is removed (${flags.join(", ")}) or when ADHD_UNSLOP_ALWAYS=0 is set. "normal mode" turns both modes off for this session.`,
+    "",
+  ].join("\n");
+}
+
+// Assemble and validate one chunk. Returns { ok: true, text } or { ok: false, reason }.
+// `root` is the plugin root that contains hooks/chunks/.
+export function renderChunk(root, index, { flags, tokenLimit = DEFAULT_TOKEN_LIMIT } = {}) {
+  if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index < 1 || index > TOTAL_CHUNKS) {
+    return { ok: false, reason: `invalid chunk index ${String(index)}` };
+  }
+  const dir = path.join(root, "hooks", "chunks");
+  let manifest;
+  try {
+    manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, "manifest.json"), "utf8"));
+  } catch {
+    return { ok: false, reason: "manifest missing or unreadable" };
+  }
+  const entry = manifest?.chunks?.[index - 1];
+  if (!entry || typeof manifest.compositeSha256 !== "string") {
+    return { ok: false, reason: "manifest malformed" };
+  }
+  let payload;
+  try {
+    payload = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, `${index}.md`), "utf8");
+  } catch {
+    return { ok: false, reason: `chunk file ${index}.md missing` };
+  }
+  if (sha256(payload) !== entry.sha256) {
+    return { ok: false, reason: `chunk ${index} hash mismatch` };
+  }
+  const id = bundleId(manifest.compositeSha256);
+  const text = chunkHeader(index, id) + payload + chunkFooter(index, id, flags);
+  if (text.length > MAX_CHARS) {
+    return { ok: false, reason: `chunk ${index} is ${text.length} characters, over ${MAX_CHARS}` };
+  }
+  const tokens = estimateTokens(text);
+  if (tokens > tokenLimit) {
+    return { ok: false, reason: `chunk ${index} is about ${tokens} tokens, over ${tokenLimit}` };
+  }
+  return { ok: true, text, tokens };
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// Install this marketplace with the real Claude Code and Codex CLIs, with no
+// keys and no sign-in, and check what each CLI loads. No model runs.
+//
+//   node tools/load-check.mjs [--claude <bin>] [--codex <bin>] [--only claude|codex] [--repo <path>]
+//
+// The repo's tracked and untracked-not-ignored files are copied into a fresh
+// git repo in a temp dir, which serves as the marketplace, so no CLI writes
+// into the working tree. Every CLI runs in throwaway homes that are deleted at
+// the end. Expected names, versions, and hook keys come from
+// tools/plugins.json and the generated plugins/*/hooks/hooks.json.
+//
+// Step one installs the authored plugins only and asserts that nothing else
+// comes with them. Step two installs the vendored plugins by name. Codex also
+// gets a catalog check through `codex app-server` (plugin/list, plugin/read,
+// hooks/list). Prints PASS and FAIL lines and exits 1 on any failure.
+
+import { spawn, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
+import fs from "node:fs";
+import os from "node:os";
+import path from "node:path";
+import readline from "node:readline";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+
+const CLI_TIMEOUT_MS = 180_000;
+const RPC_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
+const STRIPPED_ENV = ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN", "OPENAI_API_KEY", "CODEX_API_KEY"];
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- arguments
+
+function parseArgs(argv) {
+  const opts = {
+    claude: "claude",
+    codex: "codex",
+    only: null,
+    repo: path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), ".."),
+  };
+  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
+    const arg = argv[i];
+    const value = () => {
+      if (i + 1 >= argv.length) usage(`${arg} needs a value`);
+      return argv[++i];
+    };
+    if (arg === "--claude") opts.claude = value();
+    else if (arg === "--codex") opts.codex = value();
+    else if (arg === "--repo") opts.repo = value();
+    else if (arg === "--only") {
+      opts.only = value();
+      if (!["claude", "codex"].includes(opts.only)) usage(`--only takes claude or codex, not ${opts.only}`);
+    } else if (arg === "-h" || arg === "--help") usage();
+    else usage(`unknown argument ${arg}`);
+  }
+  opts.repo = path.resolve(opts.repo);
+  return opts;
+}
+
+function usage(message) {
+  if (message) console.error(message);
+  console.error("usage: node tools/load-check.mjs [--claude <bin>] [--codex <bin>] [--only claude|codex] [--repo <path>]");
+  process.exit(2);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- results
+
+let passed = 0;
+let failed = 0;
+
+function pass(name) {
+  passed++;
+  console.log(`PASS  ${name}`);
+}
+
+function fail(name, detail) {
+  failed++;
+  console.log(`FAIL  ${name}`);
+  if (detail) for (const line of String(detail).trimEnd().split("\n")) console.log(`      ${line}`);
+}
+
+function check(name, ok, detail) {
+  if (ok) pass(name);
+  else fail(name, typeof detail === "function" ? detail() : detail);
+  return ok;
+}
+
+// Thrown to stop one runtime's checks after a step that later steps need.
+class Abort extends Error {}
+
+const tail = (text, n = 20) => String(text ?? "").trimEnd().split("\n").slice(-n).join("\n");
+const sameSet = (a, b) => a.length === b.length && [...a].sort().join("\n") === [...b].sort().join("\n");
+const show = (list) => (list.length ? list.join(", ") : "(none)");
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- temp dirs
+
+const tempRoots = [];
+const children = new Set();
+
+function cleanup() {
+  for (const child of children) {
+    try { child.kill("SIGKILL"); } catch { /* already gone */ }
+  }
+  // Codex writes shell snapshots with environment variables into CODEX_HOME.
+  for (const dir of tempRoots.splice(0)) fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
+}
+
+process.on("exit", cleanup);
+for (const signal of ["SIGINT", "SIGTERM"]) process.on(signal, () => process.exit(130));
+
+function makeTempRoot() {
+  // realpath, because macOS reports /var/folders paths as /private/var/folders.
+  const dir = fs.realpathSync(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "adhd-unslop-load-")));
+  tempRoots.push(dir);
+  return dir;
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- processes
+
+function baseEnv(extra) {
+  const env = { ...process.env };
+  for (const key of STRIPPED_ENV) delete env[key];
+  return { ...env, ...extra };
+}
+
+// Every CLI call except the app-server gets stdin from /dev/null.
+function run(bin, args, { env, cwd, timeout = CLI_TIMEOUT_MS } = {}) {
+  const r = spawnSync(bin, args, { env, cwd, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"], encoding: "utf8", timeout, maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024 });
+  const output = `${r.stdout ?? ""}${r.stderr ?? ""}`;
+  let problem = null;
+  if (r.error) problem = r.error.code === "ETIMEDOUT" ? `timed out after ${timeout / 1000}s` : r.error.message;
+  else if (r.status !== 0) problem = `exit ${r.status ?? r.signal}`;
+  return { ok: !problem, problem, stdout: r.stdout ?? "", output };
+}
+
+// Run a CLI step that later steps depend on. PASS or FAIL, and abort on FAIL.
+function step(name, bin, args, opts) {
+  const r = run(bin, args, opts);
+  const cmd = [path.basename(bin), ...args].join(" ");
+  if (!check(name, r.ok, () => `$ ${cmd}\n${r.problem}\n${tail(r.output)}`)) throw new Abort(name);
+  return r;
+}
+
+function git(cwd, args) {
+  const r = spawnSync("git", args, { cwd, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"], encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024 });
+  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(" ")} failed: ${r.error?.message ?? tail(r.stderr)}`);
+  return r.stdout;
+}
+
+function cliVersion(bin, env) {
+  const r = run(bin, ["--version"], { env, timeout: 60_000 });
+  return r.ok ? r.stdout.trim() : `unavailable (${r.problem})`;
+}

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the copy
+
+// Tracked plus untracked-not-ignored files, as tests/e2e/run.sh copies them.
+// Index entries deleted from the working tree are skipped.
+function copyRepo(repo, dest) {
+  const files = git(repo, ["ls-files", "-co", "--exclude-standard", "-z"]).split("\0").filter(Boolean);
+  fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });
+  let copied = 0;
+  for (const rel of new Set(files)) {
+    const src = path.join(repo, rel);
+    let stat;
+    try { stat = fs.lstatSync(src); } catch { continue; }
+    const out = path.join(dest, rel);
+    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
+    if (stat.isSymbolicLink()) fs.symlinkSync(fs.readlinkSync(src), out);
+    else if (stat.isFile()) fs.copyFileSync(src, out);
+    else continue;
+    copied++;
+  }
+  const quiet = ["-c", "init.defaultBranch=main", "-c", "user.name=load-check", "-c", "user.email=load-check@example.invalid", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null"];
+  git(dest, [...quiet, "init", "-q"]);
+  git(dest, [...quiet, "add", "-A"]);
+  git(dest, [...quiet, "commit", "-q", "--no-verify", "-m", "load-check"]);
+  return copied;
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- expectations
+
+const snake = (event) => event.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1_$2").toLowerCase();
+
+function listFiles(dir) {
+  const out = [];
+  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return out;
+  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
+    const abs = path.join(dir, entry.name);
+    if (entry.isDirectory()) out.push(...listFiles(abs));
+    else out.push(abs);
+  }
+  return out;
+}
+
+function expectations(copy) {
+  const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(copy, "tools", "plugins.json"), "utf8"));
+  const mkt = config.marketplace.name;
+  const plugins = config.plugins.map((p) => {
+    const root = path.join(copy, "plugins", p.name);
+    const skills = p.kind === "vendored" ? [p.skill] : Object.keys(p.skills ?? {});
+    const required = [];
+    for (const skill of skills) required.push(`skills/${skill}/SKILL.md`);
+    // The hooks file Codex reads, as the Codex manifest names it, relative to the plugin root.
+    let hooksFile = "hooks/hooks.json";
+    try {
+      const codexManifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, ".codex-plugin", "plugin.json"), "utf8"));
+      if (typeof codexManifest.hooks === "string") hooksFile = codexManifest.hooks.replace(/^\.\//, "");
+    } catch { /* checked by the install steps */ }
+    const hookKeys = [];
+    const hooksPath = path.join(root, hooksFile);
+    if (fs.existsSync(hooksPath)) {
+      required.push(hooksFile);
+      const hooks = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(hooksPath, "utf8")).hooks ?? {};
+      for (const [event, groups] of Object.entries(hooks)) {
+        groups.forEach((group, g) => (group.hooks ?? []).forEach((_, h) => hookKeys.push(`${p.name}@${mkt}:${hooksFile}:${snake(event)}:${g}:${h}`)));
+      }
+    }
+    if (p.alwaysOn) {
+      required.push("hooks/chunks/manifest.json");
+      p.alwaysOn.forEach((_, i) => required.push(`hooks/chunks/${i + 1}.md`));
+    }
+    const sourceFiles = listFiles(root).map((abs) => path.relative(root, abs).split(path.sep).join("/"));
+    return {
+      name: p.name,
+      id: `${p.name}@${mkt}`,
+      kind: p.kind,
+      version: p.version,
+      skills,
+      fullSkills: skills.map((s) => `${p.name}:${s}`),
+      displayName: p.codexInterface?.displayName ?? null,
+      root,
+      required,
+      sourceFiles,
+      hooksFile,
+      hookKeys,
+    };
+  });
+  return { mkt, plugins };
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- cache checks
+
+const dirNames = (dir) => (fs.existsSync(dir) ? fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((n) => n !== ".DS_Store").sort() : []);
+
+// <cache>/<mkt>/ holds exactly the installed plugins, each with one version folder.
+function checkCacheLayout(label, mktCache, installed) {
+  const names = dirNames(mktCache);
+  check(`${label}: cache ${path.basename(mktCache)}/ holds only ${show(installed.map((p) => p.name))}`, sameSet(names, installed.map((p) => p.name)), `found: ${show(names)}`);
+  for (const p of installed) {
+    const versions = dirNames(path.join(mktCache, p.name));
+    check(`${label}: cache ${p.name}/ holds only ${p.version}/`, sameSet(versions, [p.version]), `found: ${show(versions)}`);
+  }
+}
+
+// The installed copy has the required files, and every shipped file byte for byte.
+// Extra files are allowed, so a CLI that adds metadata does not fail the check.
+function checkInstalledFiles(label, p, dir) {
+  const missing = p.required.filter((rel) => !fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, rel)));
+  check(`${label}: ${p.name} install has ${p.required.length} required files`, missing.length === 0, `missing under ${dir}:\n${missing.join("\n")}`);
+  const differ = p.sourceFiles.filter((rel) => {
+    const out = path.join(dir, rel);
+    return !fs.existsSync(out) || !fs.readFileSync(out).equals(fs.readFileSync(path.join(p.root, rel)));
+  });
+  check(`${label}: ${p.name} install matches all ${p.sourceFiles.length} shipped files`, p.sourceFiles.length > 0 && differ.length === 0, `missing or different under ${dir}:\n${differ.join("\n") || "(no shipped files found)"}`);
+}
+
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Claude Code
+
+function parseJson(text, what) {
+  const trimmed = text.trim();
+  const start = [trimmed.indexOf("["), trimmed.indexOf("{")].filter((i) => i >= 0).sort((a, b) => a - b)[0];
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(start > 0 ? trimmed.slice(start) : trimmed);
+  } catch (err) {
+    throw new Error(`${what}: not JSON (${err.message}):\n${tail(text)}`);
+  }
+}
+
+function claudeList(bin, opts, label) {
+  const r = step(`${label}: claude plugin list --json`, bin, ["plugin", "list", "--json"], opts);
+  const list = parseJson(r.stdout, "claude plugin list --json");
+  if (!Array.isArray(list)) throw new Error(`claude plugin list --json: expected an array, got ${typeof list}`);
+  return list;
+}
+
+function checkClaudeInstalled(label, list, expected, mkt, configDir) {
+  const ours = list.filter((e) => String(e.id).endsWith(`@${mkt}`));
+  check(`${label}: installed from ${mkt}: exactly ${show(expected.map((p) => p.name))}`, sameSet(ours.map((e) => e.id), expected.map((p) => p.id)), `installed: ${show(ours.map((e) => e.id))}`);
+  for (const p of expected) {
+    const entry = ours.find((e) => e.id === p.id);
+    if (!entry) continue;
+    check(`${label}: ${p.id} version ${p.version}`, entry.version === p.version, `listed version: ${entry.version}`);
+    const errors = entry.errors ?? [];
+    check(`${label}: ${p.id} reports no errors`, Array.isArray(errors) && errors.length === 0, JSON.stringify(errors, null, 2));
+    check(`${label}: ${p.id} is enabled`, entry.enabled !== false, `enabled: ${entry.enabled}`);
+    const expectedPath = path.join(configDir, "plugins", "cache", mkt, p.name, p.version);
+    check(`${label}: ${p.id} installPath is the versioned cache copy`, path.resolve(entry.installPath ?? "") === expectedPath, `installPath: ${entry.installPath}\nexpected:    ${expectedPath}`);
+    if (entry.installPath) checkInstalledFiles(label, p, entry.installPath);
+  }
+  checkCacheLayout(label, path.join(configDir, "plugins", "cache", mkt), expected);
+}
